data.group_split: leave_one_context_out; both arrangements of a context stay together
data.reason: V9 is prior development evidence; it may diagnose and train the mechanism but cannot serve as the final untouched test

pretraining_gate.formula: mean(max utility for each arrangement) - max(mean arrangement utility for each candidate id)

target.interpretation: paid-action rate of change in covered 2D area times 3D F1

features.semantic_model: common geometry plus category, measured structure, direction and confidence interactions
features.geometry_capacity_control: same 12x4x1 MLP with four nonlinear aperture-only columns
features.confidence_proxy: absolute class vote times capped marked-support fraction; development marker evidence only

network.loss: mean squared error on within-history centered primary target plus L2 weights

next_confirmation.protocol: freeze model and generate unopened contexts with varied layout, sensor noise, semantic confidence and unknown-start coverage
